scope: Check temporal filter classification for nested ROW fields and exact, REAL, and DOUBLE factors against Java. SQL includes positive and negative factors and a cloned nested row.

directed_sql: CREATE TABLE t(a ROW(ts TIMESTAMP)); CREATE VIEW v AS SELECT t.a.ts FROM t WHERE t.a.ts > NOW();
CREATE TABLE t(x DECIMAL(30, 10)); CREATE VIEW v AS SELECT x FROM t WHERE x > CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW()) AS DECIMAL(20, 0)) * 0.0001;
CREATE TABLE t(x DECIMAL(30, 10)); CREATE VIEW v AS SELECT x FROM t WHERE x > CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW()) AS DECIMAL(20, 0)) * -0.0001;
CREATE TABLE t(x REAL); CREATE VIEW v AS SELECT x FROM t WHERE x > CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW()) AS REAL) * CAST(0.125 AS REAL);
CREATE TABLE t(x REAL); CREATE VIEW v AS SELECT x FROM t WHERE x > CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW()) AS REAL) * CAST(-0.125 AS REAL);
